$comment: Analytics taxonomy — editor family. Merged with its siblings by server/analytics.taxonomy(); see _envelope.json.

editor_session_summary.$comment: Exactly one per editor session, flushed on pagehide. Per-interaction commits are counted into it, never uploaded: a 20-minute session is 50-300 commits.
editor_session_summary.question: Which editor features are used, and were they even reachable?

editor_action_blocked.$comment: ONE hook inside `flash` covers every guardrail in the editor, but ONLY when the call site supplies a `code`: a progress toast uses kind 'warn' too ('Rendering...'), and an unconditional hook would manufacture a blocked event out of normal progress.
editor_action_blocked.question: Where does user intent hit a wall? Fix the state or the copy.

editor_save_finished.$comment: FAILURES upload at 100%; successes are counted into editor_session_summary. Autosave fires 20-200x/session, so per-save upload is banned. RULES.md says a Save must never 422 — a rejected save is the contract alarm.
editor_save_finished.question: Is the shared doc safely persisted? Fix races before features.

editor_load_failed.question: Why can a project not be edited?

canvas_changed.$comment: The canvas RATIO, never the raw dimensions — a bounded vocabulary is what makes 'does anyone leave 9:16' a countable question.
canvas_changed.question: Does anyone leave 9:16? If not, delete the picker (RULES.md is vertical-only).

dirty_work_abandoned.$comment: Reachable because autosave is SUSPENDED around agent turns. This is the data-loss alarm.
dirty_work_abandoned.question: Is unsaved work being lost?

feature_first_use.$comment: The ONE per-commit upload that earns its place: bounded to at most once per feature per install by a persisted seen-set, then zero forever.
feature_first_use.question: Time-to-discovery per feature. A long lag means UI work, not more features.

agent_output_adopted.$comment: summarizeDocChange returns changed KEY NAMES, never values.
agent_output_adopted.question: Does the user KEEP what the agent did? The best agent-quality signal the editor has.

agent_adopt_failed.$comment: Replaces two bare `.catch(() => {})`. Today a turn can change disk while the live editor silently fails to adopt it — the one corruption path in the shared-doc design.
agent_adopt_failed.question: Is the screen silently diverging from disk?

user_visible_failure.$comment: One central place every red toast passes through. Toasts-per-session is the honest quality metric. The toast TEXT never ships — it interpolates file names, agent errors and API messages.
user_visible_failure.question: How many times per session does this app visibly fail a user?

schema_write_rejected.$comment: RULES.md says a Save must never 422, so this is the CONTRACT ALARM. `origin` can only ever be 'editor': the agent writes edit_decisions.json directly, so agent-authored invalid docs never reach this route. The jsonschema message quotes the OFFENDING VALUE — a source path, a caption, a project name — so only the shape of the failure travels.
schema_write_rejected.question: Does the schema contract hold? If not, fix the sanitizer.

open_vocabularies.failure_field: An edit_decisions FIELD NAME, matched against a closed list at the emit site; anything unrecognised collapses to 'unknown' rather than echoing a token the user typed.
